children: Japanese stocks may fall, tracking Wall Street's losses overnight. Persistent tensions in the Middle East and concerns over rising inflation appear to be damping investor appetite for risk assets. U.S. data released Wednesday showed consumer prices rose 3.7% on year in September, stronger than the 3.6% increase tipped by a Wall Street Journal poll of economists. Nikkei futures opened 1,850 points lower at 66310 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.06 yen versus Y158.30 around Wednesday's Tokyo market close. The Nikkei Stock Average closed 0.05% lower at 67744.29 on Wednesday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
